title: Kubeia
subtitle: A dungeon crawler inspired by Dungeons & Dragons and Greek mythology

narrative-exploration.title: Narrative exploration
narrative-exploration.description: Like a poet before his audience, we weave each story in prose. It is up to you to experience it through your choices.

characters.title: Character choice
characters.description: Play as three heroes from mythical Greece; each has their own strengths, weaknesses and challenges to overcome.

turn-based-combat.title: Turn-based combat
turn-based-combat.description: Some encounters can only be resolved at sword's point. Round after round, action after action, the dice will decide between victory and death; perhaps your own.

player-progression.title: Character progression
player-progression.description: The places you explore are full of dangers, but also secrets and lost relics. It's up to you to turn each find to your advantage.

random-generation.title: Randomly-generated environment
random-generation.description: Each attempt has its own path to discover: the gods are capricious and enjoy rolling the dice of your destiny as you go through another trial.

screenshots.caption: Create an account or play the game straight away
Choose your character and step into their own universe

highlights: Just want to play a quick game? You don't need to create an account to play.
If you would like to keep track of your progress, you can register using just a username and your email address.
Discover dice mechanics inspired by tabletop role-playing games, as well as random environment generation.
We offer you a refined visual identity: discover silhouettes coming to life on the page to illustrate the narrative.
Are you dissatisfied with the consequences of your choices? Rewrite your destiny as many times as you like.

roadmap.text: Adding background music and audio narration

footer-section.creation: Game created solo with passion: code, narration and visuals.
footer-section.made-in: Made in France, in the Centre-Val de Loire region.
